description: This file contains compatibility functions for the torch.onnx.export API, specifically handling dynamic shapes and axes conversions, including deprecated functions for converting between dynamic axes and dynamic shapes, and utilities for renaming axes and flattening nested structures.

methods.name: from_dynamic_axes_to_dynamic_shapes
methods.description: Converts dynamic axes definitions into dynamic shapes, wrapping axis names with torch.export.Dim.DYNAMIC, with deprecation warning.

methods.name: from_dynamic_shapes_to_dynamic_axes
methods.description: Converts dynamic shapes into dynamic axes by removing Dim wrapping and converting to list or dict.

methods.name: convert_str_to_export_dim
methods.description: Replaces string axis names in dynamic shapes with Dim.DYNAMIC, returning updated structure and a boolean flag.

methods.name: create_rename_mapping
methods.description: Creates a mapping from old axis names to new custom names based on input shapes and dynamic shapes.

methods.name: _get_custom_axis_name
methods.description: Retrieves the name of a Dim object or returns the string if input is a string.

methods.name: _unflatten_dynamic_shapes_with_inputs_tree
methods.description: Unflattens dynamic shapes to match the nested structure of model inputs.

methods.name: _flatten_dynamic_shapes_to_axes
methods.description: Flattens nested dynamic shapes into a list of axes and a tree structure.

methods.name: _signature
methods.description: Retrieves the signature of a model's forward method or the model itself.
